verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak layout. The headline sits alone on the left, and the product circle, CTA button and 'Out now.' are stacked into a tight cluster on the right. That leaves a large empty orange area in the middle, and the subline is separated from the headline it belonged to in the original. In A, the button nearly touches the bottom of the circle but there is still a small gap, and 'Out now.' has some breathing room. In B, the button runs right into the circle and 'Out now.' is jammed against the right end of the button with almost no gap, so its cluster is more cramped and looks like a collision.
